d: Donald Trump’s latest NATO summit appearance has reignited tensions within the Western alliance. From threatening trade restrictions against Spain to reviving his push for control over Greenland, Trump’s message to allies was clear: loyalty comes with conditions. But behind the public clashes lies a deeper European debate about the future of the transatlantic relationship. A secret meeting of European leaders reportedly explored whether Washington can still be relied upon and whether Europe needs a more independent defence strategy.
